tool_built.language: bash (bash + coreutils + git + rg only, matching lane spec)
tool_built.state_machine: receipt(engine) -> stage(copy+digest-verify+unlink, manifest.tsv) -> hold(default 86400s) -> second receipt check -> release(RELEASES.log + rm) | restore
safety_design: Every mutating subcommand requires quarantine root AND stage/restore target inside SOUJI_QUARANTINE_ALLOW (colon-separated); else rc=3 LIVE-TREE-LOCKED before the target is even read.
--dry-run works on any path (incl. live fleet) and writes nothing.
stage gates on engine verdict: SAFE + receipt in {pushed, moved-to-obsidian, stale}; rc=4 refusal otherwise, carrying engine evidence.
Original is unlinked only AFTER the quarantine copy re-hashes to the staged digest.
Secret-shaped paths refused before any read (rc=4 secrets-refusal).
Symlink in staged scope fails closed (symlink-present).
release re-runs the second receipt check itself; it never trusts prior state.
No git fetch/push/commit/branch/checkout/reset/rebase anywhere; vault read-only; .ufo/state, .ufo/watchdog.log, ~/.config untouched.

selftest.fixture_policy: mktemp -d /tmp/souji-quarantine-selftest.XXXXXX; allow-lists only that dir; trap rm -rf
selftest.first_run_honesty_note: First selftest run: 26 checks, 20 failed. Root causes found and fixed before any evidence was recorded as final: (1) inverted receipt gate — 'if [ verdict != SAFE ] || case receipt in <ok>) ;;' makes a matched (valid) receipt evaluate truthy and refuse every SAFE target; reproduced standalone with bash -c and rewritten as sequential case guards. (2) ck() grepped the whole captured output including the tool's own --help text, producing false PASSes (help contains the event-line vocabulary); fixed to match the first event line only. (3) trap 'rm -rf "$T"' referenced a function-local var under set -u at EXIT; fixed with a global. (4) one selftest assertion grepped 'RELEASES' in a log whose lines start 'RELEASED'.

tool_defects_found_by_running_and_fixed.what: case-inside-if composition inverted the refusal condition (valid receipts were refused); reproduced standalone, rewritten as sequential case guards
target column held the entry id and the canonical path was lost when the entry dir was removed on release; now writes entry=, target=, receipt=, sha256=, evidence=

allow-list lock ran after the engine read the target; moved before any read for non-dry-run stage (GD4 originally hit 'unreachable' instead of LIVE-TREE-LOCKED because SC1 had already released the probe file — driver flaw, also fixed)

deviations_from_engine_spec.note: second receipt check re-derives receipt evidence with the same primitives as the engine (rg fixed-string sweep with the engine's D3 exclusions for stale; branch -r --contains for pushed; ledger row + vault re-hash for moved-to-obsidian) instead of re-invoking souji-verify.sh, because the staged origin path no longer exists for the engine to evaluate. Stage always uses the engine verdict as the receipt of record.

restore when origin was recreated refuses (origin-exists) instead of overwriting; entry is preserved. Fail-safe: neither release nor restore proceeds; operator resolves. Not covered by prior art in the lane.

runbook_seed: gate-opening runbook for an authorized target T: (1) bash tools/souji-quarantine.impl-S12.sh --dry-run stage T  # read-only verdict; (2) SOUJI_QUARANTINE_ALLOW=<fixture-or-approved-root> ... --hold-seconds 86400 stage T; (3) status; (4) after hold: check <entry>; (5) release <entry> (re-checks internally, appends RELEASES.log); abort path: restore <entry>. Live fleet stays locked unless the operator allow-lists a root.
